law.title: Posted places (A)(5)
law.text: No person shall stop, stand or park a vehicle except when necessary to avoid conflict with other traffic in compliance with law or the directions of a police officer or a traffic control device, in any of the following places: In front of any sidewalk elevator or chute or within a space of five feet on each side of such sidewalk elevator or chute.
